result:
I’d make it so that, before someone harms another person, they can truly feel what that harm will be like for the other person—not as a punishment, but as unavoidable clarity.

Not enough to erase conflict. But enough to make cruelty harder, indifference rarer, and understanding the default instead of the exception.

Final in English.
